title: pGM-MD: polarizable Gaussian multipole electrostatics for AMBER, OpenMM and GROMACS
description: Implementations of the polarizable Gaussian multipole (pGM) model for three molecular dynamics programs: a patch for AMBER24 PMEMD (CPU and CUDA, SPFP and DPFP), an OpenMM 8 plugin (Reference, CPU, OpenCL and CUDA platforms) and a patch for GROMACS 2026.4 (CPU with domain decomposition, pGM terms on the GPU), with a shared C++ reference implementation and CUDA engine, topology converters, Gaussian van der Waals, and tests that compare the three programs at identical coordinates.
notes: core/, openmm/ and tests/ are MIT-licensed; the GROMACS patch (gromacs/) is LGPL-2.1; the AMBER patch (amber/) applies to AMBER24 and the patched PMEMD is subject to the AMBER license.
